items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Of course I played with Mr. Wilson but however when I went into the band room and he put up "Poet and Peasant" it took me two months to get back into the room.

ctx.x: Of course I played with Mr. Wilson but however when I went into the band room and he put up "Poet and Peasant" it took me two months to get back into the room. I didn't know nothing about a half note or less.
